name: README.md
html:
luiskr.com V3 — core

The shared UI/browser platform — the layer every other module builds on. core provides the JSX runtime, the component base class, the reactive store, the router, the token registries (the vocabulary the zero-hardcoding rule enforces), the i18n system, the WebGL/canvas widget infrastructure, the WASM worker pool, and every utility shared by the website, CMS, and experiments.

core has no routes and no pages — it is the platform. Nothing in website/, cms/, or experiments/ re-implements what lives here.

Architecture at a glance

tokens/        the vocabulary — every class, event, attribute, string, route, id
Component.ts   base custom element — shadow DOM, scoped ?inline SCSS, lifecycle
jsx.ts         JSX pragma → native DOM (no VDOM, no framework)
store/         tiny reactive state container + mutations
router/        hash-free history router, localized slugs
i18n.ts        locale registry, route slugs, flags
utils/         canvas/WebGL widgets, WASM pool, GPU helpers, data layer, motion
browser/       detection table shared by runtime + build manifest + ES5 loader
safari/        WebKit-specific patches (isolated, gated)
legacy-polyfills/  ES5/ES2016-era shims for the oldest tiers

Source map

Root files

FileWhat it does
Component.tsBaseComponent — the base class every custom element extends: shadow root, scoped ?inline SCSS adoption, reactive state, lifecycle hooks (onMounted/onDestroy/onUpdate), cleanup bookkeeping.
constants.tsSingle source of truth for shared constants — the zero-hardcoding rule resolves here. Re-exports the full tokens/ tree.
devlog.tsDiagnostic logger — the only sanctioned logging surface (zero console.* rule). Ring buffer on globalThis; inspect via __lkDevLog(), assert via getDevLog().
firebase.tsSplit public-site/CMS Firebase bootstrap — lazy Auth/Database SDK loading so public visitors never pay for the admin surface.
i18n.tsLocale registry — supported locales, route slugs, language options, flag metadata.
index.tsBarrel — one import surface for the whole platform.
jsx.tsNative-DOM JSX pragma (h, Fragment) — props become attributes, properties, listeners, or namespaced SVG per the tokens/jsx dictionaries.
store.tsThe reactive store — getState/commit/subscribe with mutation namespaced by the MUTATIONS tokens.
types.tsShared structural types — store shape, translation nodes, route records.
utils.tsUtility barrel — re-exports utils/ helpers.
vite.config.jsLibrary build — emits core/dist/core.js (ES module); sibling and npm specifiers stay external.

browser/ — detection

FileWhat it does
browser/browsers.tsShared browser-detection table — used by runtime code, the build manifest, and the ES5 loader's feature ladder.
browser/index.tsBarrel for the browser module.

debug/ — dev tooling

FileWhat it does
debug/params.ts?debug= URL parameter parser — every supported debug flag (e.g. webGLMode:fallback, sendNotificationTest) resolved at boot.

legacy-polyfills/ — old-engine shims

Polyfills for the ES5/ES2016-era tiers — customElements, Promise, requestAnimationFrame, IntersectionObserver, fetch, Object.assign, Array.prototype.*, NodeList.forEach — loaded only by the legacy IIFE builds so modern bundles stay clean.

locale/ — localization runtime

FileWhat it does
locale/fallback.tsBaked translation snapshot — the virtual:i18n-* build-time data every SWR fetch seeds from, so first paint never waits on Firebase.
locale/index.tsBarrel.
locale/slugs.tsLocalized route-slug resolution — maps a URL's locale prefix + slug to a route name.

router/ — client-side routing

FileWhat it does
router/index.tsHistory-API router — localized slug matching, navigate(), onRoute subscription, lazy route-chunk triggering.
router/routes.tsRoute table — name → localized path tokens + view-element tag.
router/types.tsRoute record + navigation types.
router/utils.tsPath helpers — slug parsing, locale-prefix stripping.

safari/ — WebKit patches

FileWhat it does
safari/index.tsSafari patch orchestrator — gated per-feature, applied only on WebKit.
safari/patches/Individual patches — scroll, rendering, media quirks — each one self-contained with its own detection.
safari/patches/media-figure/Media-figure-specific fixes (video decode, image swap timing).

store/ — reactive state

FileWhat it does
store/index.tsStore factory — commit/subscribe/getState, subscriber cleanup.
store/types.tsState + mutation types.
store/mutations/Per-domain mutation modules — app, modal, prefs, route, session.

tokens/ — the vocabulary

The token tree is the enforcement mechanism behind the zero-hardcoding rule: every class name, event, attribute, tag, route, string, color hook, and layout constant is declared once here and imported everywhere. Each tokens/*.ts barrel is decomposed into per-domain group objects under tokens/<domain>/ — import the group directly for tree-shaking.

BarrelDomain
tokens/classes.tsEvery CSS class — decomposed under tokens/classes/ (app, carousel, cms, dialogs, docs, footer, home, media, nav, playground, starfield, states, widgets…)
tokens/attrs.tsDOM attribute names — data-*, aria-*, role, input types — decomposed under tokens/attrs/.
tokens/css.tsCSS custom-property names (--menu-*, --skel-*, --genie-*) + CSS-value tokens.
tokens/elements.tsDOM tag names — custom-element tags + native tags.
tokens/events.tsDOM event names, custom event names, store mutation ids.
tokens/ids.tsElement ids — mount points, dialog titles, dynamically-created ids.
tokens/layout.tsSpatial tokens — Fibonacci scale, breakpoints, grid padding, masonry table.
tokens/locales.tsThe 16 supported locale codes — RTDB keys + URL prefixes.
tokens/media.tsMedia pipeline — CDN filename suffixes, sizes strings, dimensions, URLs, cache config.
tokens/motion.tsAnimation — easings, carousel timing, skeleton field, GPU classifiers, prefetch.
tokens/playground.tsEarth-playground registries — actions, music URLs, data-param keys, textures, DEFAULT_SP_GUI.
tokens/routes.tsRouting — path segments, route names, title prefixes, legacy aliases.
tokens/selectors.tsComposed querySelector patterns — derived from the class/tag registries.
tokens/starfield.tsStar-field registries — textures, lazy-data paths, taxonomy, params (see below).
tokens/strings.tsPrimitive string vocabulary — typeof results, MIME types, punctuation, units.
tokens/styles.tsBASE_HOST_STYLES — the compiled-in sheet injected into every component's shadow root.
tokens/theme.tsTheme/preference tokens — dark/light/system, reduced-motion, switch ids, arrow directions.
tokens/data.tsData-layer tokens — storage keys, CMS node paths, UI copy keys, WASM actions, notify levels.

tokens/starfield/params/ — the star-field tuning surface

FileWhat it does
params.tsEngine parameters barrel — camera rig, fly-to timing, approach thresholds, procedural palette.
params/bodies.tsPer-body tuning — Sgr A* composite, belts, LOD radii, photo-masks, halos, coronae.
params/camera.tsCamera rig + navigation — FOV, far/near, tween, idle drift, orbit bounds.
params/catalog.tsCatalog-facing params — body ids, procedural material palette (spectral tints, greys, hues).
params/post.tsPost chain — bloom/vignette/grain RenderPipeline tuning.
params/scale.tsAstronomical scale — three-tier distance compression, Milky Way disc, solar shrink.
params/scene.tsScene shells + 2D fallback field tuning.
params/spiral.tsSpiral-galaxy point-cloud params — golden-ratio arms, pitch, knots, dust.
params/weather.tsLiving-planet params — cloud field, jet streams, ITCZ, hurricanes, aurorae, solar wind.
params/worker.tsWorker-dispatch + deep-field layer tuning — packed HYG/Hipparcos format.

utils/ — the utility belt

FileWhat it does
utils/index.tsBarrel for the shared utilities.
utils/aspect.tsAspect-ratio math — keeps media boxes proportional for skeletons/placeholders.
utils/dom.tsShadow-piercing DOM queries + SVG placeholder helper — app code can reach inside component shadow trees.
utils/notify.tsNotification service — native Notification when allowed, <site-toast> pill as guaranteed fallback.
utils/schema.tsJSON-LD builders (Organization, WebSite, ItemList, Article, VideoObject) + updateJsonLd().
utils/service-worker.tsStale service-worker eviction — shared by every bundle entry.
utils/string.tsPure string transforms — HTML stripping, slug/case helpers.
utils/media.tsMedia-URL builders — the single place the CDN filename grammar is assembled.

utils/canvas/ — the WebGL widget infrastructure

Every animated canvas widget on the site — flag, burger, sliders, skeleton, menu background, close buttons — runs through this shared pipeline: one GL context-pool manager, shared program boilerplate, context-loss plumbing, and a single webglAllowed() choke point (which ?debug=webGLMode:fallback flips).

FileWhat it does
canvas/css-color.tsCSS-color parser → 0–1 RGB triples for shader uniforms.
canvas/dom-font.tsDOM-faithful ctx.font builder for text re-rasterization.
canvas/gl-lifecycle.tsContext-loss + release plumbing — never preventDefault a loss, always loseContext() on destroy.
canvas/gl-program.tsShared quad-shader boilerplate — compile, link, upload, blend.
canvas/webgl-mode.tswebglAllowed()/webglContext() — the single WebGL choke point; ?debug=webGLMode:fallback forces every path to CSS/2D.
canvas/webgl-pool.tsLifecycle pool for shared GL contexts — IntersectionObserver purges offscreen contexts, restores on re-entry (browsers cap ~16).

utils/canvas/loaders/ — visual loading states

FileWhat it does
loaders/intro-loader.tsBoot overlay — glow veil + ring + percent + brand, honors reduced motion.
loaders/menu-background-webgl.tsNav-menu fullscreen FBM contour field (Iris van Herpen–inspired isolines), theme-aware ink, CSS moiré fallback.
loaders/skeleton-webgl.tsWebGL skeleton shimmer — pooled renderer draws organic shimmer over placeholder geometry; CSS fallback on software renderers.

utils/canvas/widgets/ — the WebGL UI widgets

FileWhat it does
widgets/burger-button-webgl.tsAnimated hamburger icon — three waving rounded bars, CSS fallback button.
widgets/carousel-controls.tsCarousel arrow — circular progress ring + arrow morph, play/pause variant, pooled.
widgets/close-button.tsAnimated X button — liquid-fill close, Canvas2D fallback, facade over close-button/.
widgets/flag-webgl.tsWaving-flag renderer — per-locale flags as animated shader (split/hybrid flags supported).
widgets/switch-slider.tsToggle switch — SDF pill + knob, spring easing, 2D fallback.
widgets/theme-slider.tsThree-position theme slider — sun→monitor→moon morph, drag + tap + keyboard.

Each widget's heavy internals live under widgets/<name>/ — shaders, init, render loop, fallback painters, theme sampling.

utils/data/ — the data layer

FileWhat it does
data/db.tsSWR-style data layer over Firebase RTDB — translation nodes resolve instantly from the baked snapshot, then silently revalidate live.
data/legal-links.tsBuilds the bundled legal link list per locale (shared by footer + awards).
data/sanitize.tsDependency-free HTML sanitizer — DOMParser + allowlist walk; protects CMS/i18n HTML.

utils/gpu/ — GPU helpers

FileWhat it does
gpu/gpu-accel.tsLazily-created offscreen WebGL2 pipeline for media uploads + compositor promotion.
gpu/gpu-accel-shaders.tsThe passthrough blit shader.
gpu/gpu-info.tsGPU capability probe — renderer string classification, powerPreference hints.
gpu/npu-predict.tsHardware-tiered prefetch predictor — WebNN NPU → WebGL → WASM fallback.

utils/motion/ — motion + transitions

FileWhat it does
motion/genie.ts"Genie" dialog transition — dialog scales from its trigger via --genie-x/y, zooms back on close.
motion/route-warmer.tsPost-load route-chunk warming — idle-imports each route bundle so navigation is instant.
motion/scroll-state.tsGlobal scrolling flag + onScrollStop() — defers expensive work until scroll settles.

utils/perf/ — stats

FileWhat it does
perf/stats-engine.tsLive metrics collector for the stats HUD — FPS, network, longtask CPU, heap, latency.
perf/stats/flush.ts, fps.ts, network.tsThe per-domain samplers.

utils/wasm/ — the WASM worker pool

Batch CPU work (layout math, hashing, image decode, easing curves) routes through a lazily-spawned pool of wasm-worker.js Web Workers — zero-copy transfers where possible, structuredClone otherwise, JS fallback everywhere.

FileWhat it does
wasm/wasm-pool.tsRound-robin dispatcher over the worker pool — transferables auto-detected, null on every failure path.
wasm/wasm-css.tsDynamic CSS injector — owns the <style id="wasm-dynamic-css"> node.
wasm/wasm-image-decoder.tsImage decode → createImageBitmap → GPU upload pipeline.
wasm/wasm-layout.tsLayout/animation math with WASM fast path + identical JS fallback.
wasm/wasm-media-threads.tsOff-main-thread media pipeline — decode, probe, prefetch, byte-range fetch.
wasm/wasm-scroll.tsrAF smooth scroller using the WASM ease curve.

Commands

yarn dev      # module dev server (library mode)
yarn test     # jest suite for core
yarn build    # emits core/dist/core.js

The root yarn dev mounts this module through the app shell; a standalone yarn dev here runs only the library entry.

Submodule of luiskr.com-V3. Install deps from the superproject (yarn install at the root), then run yarn dev / yarn test / yarn build in this folder — see package.json scripts.
